headline: "Korean-Style AMPC Introduction Benefits Solar Sector; Hanwha Solutions and Others in Focus"
summary: Korea Investment & Securities says a government plan for a Korean advanced manufacturing production tax credit covering six strategic industries should benefit domestic solar companies. The credit requires both domestic production and domestic sales.
why: Hanwha Solutions is a major Korean solar module maker, so changes to production tax credits affect its margins and competitive position.
